original_turn.question: Apple在AI战略方面有哪些最新进展？与OpenAI的合作细节是什么？
original_turn.search_summary: Apple Intelligence launched with iOS 19 in June 2025. On-device AI processing via A18 chip. Partnership with OpenAI: ChatGPT integrated into Siri, free for users, no account required. Private Cloud Compute for complex queries. 15 billion parameter on-device model. Privacy-first approach with on-device processing as default.
original_turn.answer: 苹果在2025年6月随iOS 19推出了Apple Intelligence。核心是与OpenAI的合作——ChatGPT集成到Siri中，用户无需注册账号即可免费使用。技术架构上采用端侧AI处理（A18芯片），设备端模型参数规模约150亿。复杂查询通过Private Cloud Compute处理。隐私策略是默认在设备端处理，不上传数据到云端。

labeled_facts: Apple Intelligence launched with iOS 19 in June 2025
No account required for ChatGPT in Siri — free for users
On-device AI processing via A18 chip
On-device model has approximately 15 billion parameters
Private Cloud Compute handles complex queries
